profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Goal-driven Computer Scientist with a passion for building innovative technologies through VR. Highly motivated to not only learn new concepts, but also collaborate with others while demonstrating exceeding attention to detail and efficiency.

positions.title: Software, Robotics and Simulations Division
positions.description:
Spacecraft Software Engineering Intern
• Incorporated brain computer interfacing to demonstrate applications in astronaut training.
• Implemented custom blueprint visual scripts to provide UI elements visualizing real-time data tracking through a VR heads-up display. 
• Developed and debugged program functions designed to extract raw electroencephalogram (EEG) data values. 
• Developed deep learning algorithms for mental state identification as well as providing training data that can be used for a variety of other applications.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration

positions.title: Peer Led Team Learning / Collaborative Learning Community Center
positions.description:
PLTL Computer Science Tutor 
•	Organized effective study methods with other students to help accelerate learning progress.
•	Outlined effective new teaching techniques with other tutors through team-based exercises. 
•	Maintained a clean and orderly study area while routinely checking all computer lab equipment.

positions.title: UHD Brain Computer Interface (BCI) Research
positions.description:
Researcher
•	Created Experiment Protocols that utilized EEG headsets to record BCI brainwaves.  
•	Developed stress and frustration inducing games and activities to effectively create solutions 
        within experiment sessions.
•	Presented at HENAAC Conference: Poster Presentation (Pasadena, CAL: Oct 2017)

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
DI (Digital Imaging) Specialist / Sales Representative  
•	Welcomed guests into the store, directed traffic flow throughout the sales floor to ensure maximum efficiency as well as providing further customer service needs
•	Created imaging solutions to a wide range of customers including professional photographers by
demonstrating the capabilities of mirrorless full-frame interchangeable lens systems
•	Utilized a vast array of unique camera lens to help customers unleash their full creativity
•	Worked other team members in PA (Personal Audio), TV, and PlayStation departments in multiple
networking projects

projects.title: Cube Runner - VR
projects.description:
-Personal Project-
Simple VR game using Unity 3D Game Engine. Using Oculus SDK and basic Unity assets. Project intended to further expand knowledge in VR development.

projects.title: EXPLORATION - Learning Management System
projects.description:
Team Leader - Software Engineering Course Project 
Delegated Tasks and organized workflow in developing a web-app LMS that manages student/faculty data
